entries.title: Agent stdout idle watchdog

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.semantics: Elapsed > threshold; only CAFE-read stdout lines or drained supported native activity reset idle time. Stderr and unseen tool output do not. Activity is not completion.
Elapsed > threshold; only CAFE-read stdout lines or drained supported native activity reset idle time. Stderr and unseen tool output do not. Activity is not completion.

entries.trigger: Managed CLI stops producing observed activity.
entries.detection: Idle diagnostics and observed stdout/native activity timestamps.
entries.mitigation: Split work within the threshold or verify progress reaches CAFE stdout/supported native activity; preserve child exit status and separate completion evidence. Unseen background terminal output is insufficient.
entries.escalation: Declare constraint_assistance before starting work without observable progress.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Post-output process exit wait

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.semantics: Wait starts after stdout consumption; timeout terminates with bounded kill cleanup. Existing terminal-evidence success rules remain.

entries.trigger: Stdout consumption finishes but process remains alive.
entries.impact: Process is terminated after exit wait.
entries.mitigation: Ensure children close stdout and exit; verify explicit completion and exit status.
entries.escalation: Record interruption evidence and request bounded recovery through existing routes.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Structured terminal evidence

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: Parsed structured streams with durable output or explicit terminal requirement need result or turn.completed; process exit alone is insufficient.

entries.trigger: Structured execution has a terminal requirement.
entries.mitigation: Collect explicit terminal and required handoff evidence; do not treat progress as completion.
entries.escalation: Retry through existing recovery with this ID.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Streaming error retention limitation

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: Sanitized persistence truncates earlier streaming records to one safe error plus diagnostics.

entries.trigger: A streamed execution error is persisted.
entries.impact: Pre-error records in the streaming file are lost.
entries.detection: One sanitized error record replaces prior file contents.
entries.mitigation: Diagnose using durable sanitized diagnostics; do not claim lost records are recoverable or disable sanitization.
entries.escalation: Refer to #492 for the separate retention repair.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Callback execution attempt budget

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.semantics: Per builtin bootstrap/delivery attempt, including retained native activity; not a total detached delivery wall-clock bound or native queue acceptance guarantee.

entries.trigger: Builtin callback launches bootstrap or delivery attempt.
entries.impact: An attempt exceeding time/output budget is stopped.
entries.detection: AgentExecutionControl limit diagnostics and callback receipts.
entries.mitigation: Keep callbacks brief and bounded; inspect current facts, use ordinary workflow execution for larger work.
entries.escalation: Use existing workflow recovery and assistance routes.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Detached callback delivery

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: Asynchronous, best-effort, non-gating delivery; launch acceptance does not prove model handling or OS/webhook notification.

entries.impact: Workflow does not observe delivery result.
entries.mitigation: Distinguish launch, acceptance, model completion and notification; inspect receipts before claiming handling.
entries.escalation: Use separately authorized notification capabilities if required.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Callback worker ownership boundary

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: Session/dispatch locks confer no worker PID registry, cancellation authority or safe workflow-worker stop channel.

entries.trigger: Callback inspects or considers controlling a workflow worker.
entries.impact: Inferred process control can target the wrong worker.
entries.detection: Detached launcher has no worker ownership or stop contract.
entries.mitigation: Refresh worker state and use existing authorized control paths; never kill an inferred PID.
entries.escalation: Escalate worker control through existing authority.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: User-required HumanTask authority

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: Mandatory/user-required decisions and capability/permission approval remain human-only; confirmed eligible automation contracts retain existing behavior.

entries.trigger: An agent or callback considers answering a HumanTask.
entries.impact: An unauthorized answer cannot advance the workflow.
entries.detection: Inspect task authority decision and confirmed contract.
entries.mitigation: Route mandatory/user-required decisions through the existing HumanTask; never infer authority from this registry.
entries.escalation: Request the user's decision via the existing handoff.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.

entries.title: Configured chain boundary

lifecycle.historical_evidence: Bounded Git history and current source inspected at ba2fab07b93061a59ebc2d4638ea158e6690a87d; first release not established. Observed behavior predates registry publication.

boundary.rule: A single-entry chain has no backup; failure is re-raised. Only explicitly configured multi-entry chains allow existing fallback behavior.

entries.trigger: Primary fails and no fallback entry exists.
entries.detection: Inspect configured chain and failed attempt evidence.
entries.mitigation: Do not infer or append backups; retain the confirmed chain.
entries.permission_boundary: Guidance grants no host action, worker ownership, permission approval or workflow advancement authority.
